decisions.reason: Retaining horizontal scrolling on the mobile pricing table does not change the required itemized service coverage, exact pricing breakdown, or classification rules.
The mobile table layout decision does not change the pricing-area navigation entry or its detailed-pricing destination.
Horizontal scrolling is a mobile presentation behavior and does not alter the package count, square-footage categories, pricing matrix, or package prices.
The responsive pricing-table layout does not change the one-time pricing model or the removal of monthly and annual tabs.

The animation choice is a separate decision expressed in the same message and is already represented by the candidate's message-76 MODIFY; the mobile pricing-layout decision requires no additional change.
Retaining horizontal scrolling in the mobile pricing table does not change the homepage buttons or their page destinations.
The pricing-table decision does not affect the homepage design direction, image emphasis, or blue overlay treatment.
The mobile pricing layout does not alter gallery scrolling, gallery tabs, or secondary gallery content.
Retaining the existing mobile pricing-table scrolling behavior does not change the sitewide requirement for image-focused visual design.
The pricing-table layout decision does not change the requirement to associate each listed service with a relevant image.
The source pricing decision concerns the mobile pricing table, while the animation clause is resolved by context as the separate gallery-hover requirement rather than the homepage gallery animation.
The deferred quote calculator's calculation rules and outputs are independent of the mobile presentation behavior of the current pricing table.
